why: Both reach the same hedgehog (branded paper-based consumer products, profit per consumer brand) and surface both key brutal facts, but Analysis 1 commits unequivocally to selling the mills including the namesake and the specialty papers, whereas Analysis 2 hedges the namesake mill and only says divest or harvest specialty papers later. Analysis 1 is also slightly better calibrated: its gate tally is correct while Analysis 2 miscounts its own (states 6 PASS / 5 CONDITIONAL when its log shows 7 / 4), and it says explicitly what evidence would weaken the mill-sale case.
